change_markers.what_was_wrong: The operating-decline gate applied company rules to funds and investment trusts. Their revenue line is investment income or portfolio return and they have no operating margin, so part 2 ('no sign of declining operating performance') was judged on inputs that do not exist for them. GCP.L (GCP Infrastructure Investments, buy tier) was declining on a fall in investment income; PSH.L, BHMG.L and III.L were clear on the same kind of figures.
change_markers.fix: src/value_investor/fund_or_trust.py classifies a name as a fund or trust from a reviewed override list (docs/data/fund_or_trust_overrides.json), then sector label, Yahoo industry or quote type, then 'investment trust' / 'fund' (not 'fund management') in the name; REITs are operating. The gate returns insufficient_data with reason fund_or_trust and keeps the company-rule verdict as company_rules_verdict. The sector gate leaves fund members out of decline and earnings breadth and their coverage base.
change_markers.effect: As of 2026-11-10: 8 FTSE names classified; 5 change verdict (GCP.L and 3IN.L declining, PSH.L, BHMG.L and III.L clear, all now insufficient_data). FTSE buy tier: GCP.L only, which failed entry before and after. No library verdict and no sector verdict changed.
